四台相机：1280 × 720 × 3 × 30 + 2 × 640 × 480 × 3 × 30 + 848 × 480 × 2 × 30 ≈ 162.7 MB/s；四个麦克风 128 kB/s；IMU 20 kB/s；21 个关节 252 kB/s；两个力传感器 48 kB/s。合计约 163 MB/s，相机占 99.7%，一小时 587 GB。同一句"把那杯水递给我"写成文字，每秒只有十几个字节，差了一千多万倍。图像变词元：π0 用的视觉–语言模型 PaliGemma 把图缩成 224 像素的方图（openpi），14 像素一块（Beyer 等 2024），nimg = (224 / 14)² = 16² = 256；三台彩色相机每秒看 10 次，就是每秒 7680 个词元。Four cameras: 1280 × 720 × 3 × 30 + 2 × 640 × 480 × 3 × 30 + 848 × 480 × 2 × 30 ≈ 162.7 MB/s; four microphones 128 kB/s; the IMU 20 kB/s; 21 joints 252 kB/s; two force sensors 48 kB/s. In total about 163 MB/s, 99.7% of it from the cameras, or 587 GB an hour. The same sentence, "pass me that glass of water", written out as text, is only a dozen or so bytes a second: more than ten million times less. From image to tokens: PaliGemma, the vision–language model that π0 uses, shrinks each image to a 224-pixel square (openpi) and cuts it into 14-pixel patches (Beyer et al. 2024), so nimg = (224 / 14)² = 16² = 256; if the model looks at three colour cameras 10 times a second, that is 7680 tokens a second.

原始数据大部分是重复的：相邻两帧几乎一样。视频压缩就是靠这一点把它压小几十到上百倍，模型也只是每隔一阵看一眼缩小后的图。可"记住"仍然很贵：要让一个 8B 的模型记住最近一分钟看到的东西，46 万个词元的键值缓存就要 60 GB（第 ⑦ 步）；何况 Llama 3.1 8B 一次最多只能看 131 072 个词元（Meta 的配置文件），46 万是它的 3.5 倍。所以机器人的记忆要靠别的办法：少看、看小图、只记关键的几帧，或者把过去压缩成几句话。Most of the raw data is repetition: two neighbouring frames are almost the same. Video compression relies on exactly this to make it tens to hundreds of times smaller, and the model, too, only glances at a shrunk image every so often. But "remembering" is still expensive: for an 8B model to remember what it saw over the last minute, the KV cache for 460,000 tokens takes 60 GB (step ⑦); and in any case Llama 3.1 8B can look at no more than 131,072 tokens at once (Meta’s configuration file), and 460,000 is 3.5 times that. So a robot’s memory has to rely on other tricks: look less often, look at smaller images, keep only a few key frames, or compress the past into a few sentences.

每块芯片一个钟A clock in every chip

第 ① 步说过，芯片靠时钟一步一步走。时钟的源头是一小片切好的石英：通上电，它以一个非常稳定的频率振动（比如每秒 2500 万次），叫晶振；芯片里的锁相环（PLL）再把它乘到每秒几十亿次。机器人身上的芯片大多有自己的钟，多半来自它自己的晶振：主计算模块一个，FPGA 一个，每个关节的单片机一个，相机里也有一个；IMU 这样的小芯片常常不接石英，用芯片里自带的振荡器。就算标的都是"每秒 2500 万次"，实际也总有一点点偏差：常见的晶振在室温下就有 ±10 到 ±30 ppm（ppm 是百万分之一），温度一变还会再偏一些。Step ① said that a chip moves forward one step at a time, driven by its clock. The clock starts with a tiny, precisely cut piece of quartz: with power applied, it vibrates at a very stable frequency (say 25 million times a second), and this is called a crystal oscillator; a phase-locked loop (PLL) inside the chip then multiplies that up to billions of times a second. Most chips on the robot have a clock of their own, usually from their own crystal: one for the main compute module, one for the FPGA, one for each joint’s microcontroller, and one inside each camera too; small chips like the IMU often have no quartz and use an oscillator built into the chip. Even if they are all marked "25 million times a second", there is always a tiny error in practice: a common crystal is off by ±10 to ±30 ppm (ppm means parts per million) even at room temperature, and drifts a little more when the temperature changes.

百万分之二十听起来很小：一小时是 3600 秒，两块芯片要是一个快 20 ppm、一个慢 20 ppm，一小时就能差出 3600 × 40 × 10−6 ≈ 0.14 秒。可机器人要把不同传感器在同一时刻的数据放在一起用：相机看到杯子在哪，要配上拍照那一刻头转到了哪个角度（来自关节和 IMU）。时间对错了，杯子就被放到了错的地方。头每秒转 90 度时，时间差 10 ms，方向就差 0.9 度，两米外的杯子差出 3 厘米；手每秒移动 1 米时，10 ms 就是 1 厘米。Twenty parts per million sounds tiny. An hour is 3600 seconds, though, so if one chip runs 20 ppm fast and another 20 ppm slow, after an hour they can be 3600 × 40 × 10−6 ≈ 0.14 seconds apart. And the robot has to combine data that different sensors took at the same moment: where the camera sees the glass has to be matched with the angle the head was turned to at the instant the picture was taken (from the joints and the IMU). Get the time wrong, and the glass is put in the wrong place. With the head turning at 90 degrees a second, a 10 ms error in time is 0.9 degrees in direction, and a glass two metres away is off by 3 centimetres; with the hand moving at 1 metre a second, 10 ms is 1 centimetre.

办法有几种，常常一起用。硬件触发：由一块 FPGA 发出一根信号线，几台相机在同一个时刻一起曝光，FPGA 同时记下这一刻。时间戳：每个数据一产生，就记下"按共同的那个钟，现在是几点"，后面的程序只信时间戳，不信数据什么时候到。对钟：让所有芯片的钟向一个主钟看齐，网络上用的是 PTP（精确时间协议，IEEE 1588），EtherCAT 总线有自己的分布式时钟；第 5 篇第 ⑩ 步讲过这些线。There are several fixes, often used together. Hardware trigger: an FPGA sends a signal down one wire so that the cameras all expose at the same instant, and the FPGA notes that instant as it does so. Timestamps: as soon as each piece of data is produced, it is stamped with "the time now, by the shared clock", and the programs further on trust only the timestamp, never the time the data happens to arrive. Clock synchronisation: every chip’s clock is brought into line with one master clock; over a network this is done with PTP (the Precision Time Protocol, IEEE 1588), and the EtherCAT bus has its own distributed clocks; step ⑩ of page 5 covered these links.

θ = ((t2 − t1) − (t4 − t3)) / 2δ = ((t2 − t1) + (t4 − t3)) / 2

主钟在 t1 发一条消息，从钟在自己的 t2 收到；从钟在自己的 t3 回一条，主钟在 t4 收到。从钟比主钟快了多少，等于"去程看到的差"减"回程看到的差"再除以 2；线上走一趟要多久，等于两者相加再除以 2。The master clock sends a message at t1, and the slave clock receives it at its own t2; the slave replies at its own t3, and the master receives the reply at t4. How far the slave is ahead of the master is "the difference seen on the way out" minus "the difference seen on the way back", divided by 2; how long one trip along the wire takes is the two added together, divided by 2.

去程的差 t2 − t1 里，混着"路上走的时间"和"两个钟的差"；回程的差 t4 − t3 里，路上时间一样，钟的差却反了号。两者一减，路上时间消掉，剩下两倍的钟差；一加，钟差消掉，剩下两倍的路上时间。前提是来回路上一样长。时间戳要是由网卡在消息进出的那一刻用硬件打上，而不是等软件慢慢处理，误差可以小到微秒以下（IEEE 1588）。The outbound difference t2 − t1 mixes "the time spent on the way" with "the difference between the two clocks"; in the return difference t4 − t3, the time on the way is the same, but the clock difference has the opposite sign. Subtract one from the other and the travel time cancels, leaving twice the clock difference; add them and the clock difference cancels, leaving twice the travel time. This assumes the trip takes equally long each way. If the timestamps are put on in hardware by the network card at the instant the message goes out or comes in, rather than waiting for software to get round to it, the error can be below a microsecond (IEEE 1588).

t1, t4
主钟记下的发出、收到时刻send and receive times recorded by the master clock
t2, t3
从钟记下的收到、发出时刻receive and send times recorded by the slave clock
θ
从钟比主钟快了多少（偏移），show far the slave clock is ahead of the master (the offset), s
δ
消息单程走了多久，show long the message takes one way, s

t1 = 100.000 000 s，t2 = 100.000 150 s（从钟的读数），t3 = 100.000 300 s，t4 = 100.000 250 s：θ = (150 − (−50)) / 2 µs = 100 µs，δ = (150 + (−50)) / 2 = 50 µs。从钟把自己往回拨 100 µs，就和主钟对齐了。要是每秒只这样拨一次、不管快慢，两次之间每个从钟最多漂 ±20 ppm × 1 s = 20 µs，两个从钟之间最多差 40 µs；实际的 PTP 还会按几次测出的 θ 把从钟的快慢也调过来（linuxptp），两次之间几乎不再漂，网卡用硬件打时间戳时整体好于 100 ns（EndRun）。t1 = 100.000 000 s, t2 = 100.000 150 s (the slave’s reading), t3 = 100.000 300 s, t4 = 100.000 250 s: θ = (150 − (−50)) / 2 µs = 100 µs, δ = (150 + (−50)) / 2 = 50 µs. The slave sets itself back by 100 µs, and it agrees with the master. If it made this correction only once a second and did nothing about running fast or slow, each slave could drift by up to ±20 ppm × 1 s = 20 µs between corrections, and two slaves could be up to 40 µs apart; real PTP also uses the θ measured over several rounds to correct the slave’s rate (linuxptp), so it hardly drifts at all between corrections, and with hardware timestamps in the network card it does better than 100 ns overall (EndRun).

对钟只解决"大家的钟一样"；数据什么时候真正被测到，还要知道每个传感器从测量到发出的延迟（比如相机的曝光时间、读出时间），这要标定。相机和 IMU 之间的时间差，就常常被当成一个未知量和别的参数一起估出来（Furgale 等 2013）。Clock synchronisation only makes sure "everyone’s clocks agree". To know when the data was really measured, you also need each sensor’s delay from measurement to output (for a camera, say, its exposure time and readout time), and that takes calibration. The time offset between a camera and an IMU, for instance, is often treated as one more unknown and estimated together with the other parameters (Furgale et al. 2013).

  • 按钮选数据或时钟。Use the buttons to choose Data or Clocks.
  • 数据：改相机的台数、分辨率、帧率，看每个传感器每秒交出多少字节（对数刻度），合计多少；再拖模型每秒看几次和要记住最近多久，看每秒多少词元、键值缓存要多大，和主计算模块的内存比一比。Data: change the number of cameras, the resolution and the frame rate, and see how many bytes each sensor delivers per second (on a log scale) and the total; then drag Model looks per second and Remember the last to see how many tokens arrive per second and how big the KV cache gets, compared with the main compute module’s memory.
  • 时钟：相机、IMU、关节驱动器三块芯片各有一个自己的钟，拖滑块改它们各偏多少 ppm；选不对钟、开机对一次、PTP 每秒对一次、硬件触发，看一分钟、一小时以后时间戳差多少，手和杯子的位置会错多少。Clocks: three chips, the camera, the IMU and a joint driver, each have a clock of their own; drag the sliders to change how many ppm each one is off. Choose No sync, Synced once at power-on, PTP once a second or Hardware trigger, and see how far apart the timestamps are after a minute and after an hour, and how far wrong the positions of the hand and the glass would be.

先玩：在"数据"里把相机换成 1080p、60 帧：每小时多少 TB？让模型每秒看 30 次、记住 10 分钟：键值缓存放得进 128 GB 吗？在"时钟"里选"开机对一次"：一小时后差多少毫秒？换成 PTP 呢？Try first: in "Data", switch the cameras to 1080p at 60 fps: how many TB an hour? Let the model look 30 times a second and remember 10 minutes: does the KV cache fit in 128 GB? In "Clocks", choose "Synced once at power-on": how many milliseconds apart after an hour? And with PTP?

这一步的要点：机器人每秒吞进上百 MB，几乎全是相机；变成词元后每秒几千个，记住一分钟就要几十 GB。大多数芯片有自己的钟，钟会漂；要把不同传感器同一时刻的数据放在一起用，得靠硬件触发、时间戳和 PTP 这类对钟办法。The point of this step: every second the robot takes in over a hundred MB, almost all of it from the cameras; turned into tokens, that is a few thousand a second, and remembering one minute takes tens of GB. Most chips have their own clock, and clocks drift; to use data that different sensors took at the same moment together, you need hardware triggers, timestamps and clock synchronisation such as PTP.

第 ⑫ 步 · 具身智能要什么Step ⑫ · What embodied AI needs

来得及、记得住、带得动Keep up, remember, carry the load

聊天机器人慢一点没关系：回答晚两秒，你等一等就是了。厨房里的机器人不行：杯子在动，你的手在动，它自己也在动。它对计算的要求，可以归成五条：A chatbot can afford to be a little slow: if the answer comes two seconds late, you just wait. A robot in the kitchen can’t: the glass is moving, your hand is moving, and the robot itself is moving. What it asks of its computing comes down to five things:

  • 看得多：每秒几千个图像词元，还在不停地来（第 ⑪ 步）。See a lot: a few thousand image tokens a second, and they never stop coming (step ⑪).
  • 来得及：手臂每 20 ms 要一个新动作（每秒 50 次）；杯子开始滑，要在几毫秒内反应。慢一拍，就撞上、抓空、洒了。Keep up: the arm needs a new action every 20 ms (50 times a second); when the glass starts to slip, the robot has to react within a few milliseconds. A beat too slow, and it bumps into things, grasps thin air or spills the water.
  • 记得住：刚才把杯子放哪了、你说的是哪一杯，要记住几分钟甚至几小时。Remember: where it put the glass a moment ago, which glass you meant: these have to be remembered for minutes or even hours.
  • 带得动：所有计算靠一块电池。像 Jetson Thor 这样的模块功率是 40 到 130 W（NVIDIA 2026）；1X 的家用人形机器人 NEO 电池 842 Wh、能跑 4 小时（1X），模块一直跑满 130 W，一小时就用掉约 15%。还要能散掉热；不能背一柜子 GPU。Carry the load: all the computing runs on one battery. A module like Jetson Thor draws 40 to 130 W (NVIDIA 2026); 1X’s home humanoid robot NEO has an 842 Wh battery that lasts 4 hours (1X), and a module running flat out at 130 W would use about 15% of it every hour. The heat has to be got rid of too; the robot can’t carry a rack of GPUs on its back.
  • 不能掉线：网络会卡、会断，机器人不能因此僵在半空。Don’t drop out: networks stall and cut out, and the robot must not freeze in mid-air when they do.

今天的做法，是把"想"拆成快慢两个系统，再把最快的反应留给不用大模型的控制环（第 5 篇）。慢系统是一个视觉–语言模型，几十亿个参数，几秒到几分之一秒想一次，管"现在该做哪一步、目标在哪"；快系统小得多，每秒几十到上百次地把慢系统的意图和眼前的画面变成手臂的动作。Figure 2025 年的 Helix 用一个 70 亿参数的模型每秒想 7 到 9 次，一个 8000 万参数的模型每秒出 200 次动作，两者各占机器人身上的一块低功耗 GPU（Figure 2025）；2026 年 1 月的 Helix 02 又在最下面加了一层每秒上千次的 System 0，管稳定、自然的全身动作，它也是学出来的网络，取代了手写的控制（Interesting Engineering 2026）；NVIDIA 的 GR00T N1 也是这样分成两层，慢的每秒 10 次，快的每秒 120 次（NVIDIA 2025）。Today’s approach is to split "thinking" into fast and slow systems, and to leave the very fastest reactions to control loops that need no large model (page 5). The slow system is a vision–language model with billions of parameters; it thinks anywhere from once every few seconds to a few times a second, and decides "which step to do now, and where the target is". The fast system is much smaller: tens to hundreds of times a second, it turns the slow system’s intent and the scene in front of it into arm movements. Figure’s 2025 Helix uses a 7-billion-parameter model that thinks 7 to 9 times a second and an 80-million-parameter model that outputs actions 200 times a second, each on its own low-power GPU on the robot (Figure 2025); Helix 02, in January 2026, added one more layer at the very bottom, System 0, running over a thousand times a second to keep whole-body movement steady and natural; it too is a learned network, and it replaced hand-written control (Interesting Engineering 2026); NVIDIA’s GR00T N1 is split into two layers in the same way, the slow one running 10 times a second and the fast one 120 times (NVIDIA 2025).

另一个办法是一次多交几步：动作模型不是每次只出"下一个动作"，而是出接下来一整段，叫动作块。π0 一次交出 50 个动作；在每秒执行 50 个动作的机器人上，它每执行完 25 个就重算一次，也就是每秒只要算两次（Black 等 2024）；为了不在两块之间停顿，下一块在上一块还没执行完时就开始算（Black 等 2025）。Another trick is to hand over several steps at once: instead of producing only "the next action" each time, the action model produces a whole stretch of the actions to come, called an action chunk. π0 hands over 50 actions at a time; on a robot that executes 50 actions a second, it recomputes after every 25 have been carried out, so it needs to compute only twice a second (Black et al. 2024); to avoid a pause between chunks, the next chunk starts computing before the previous one has finished executing (Black et al. 2025).

tcall ≈ max(2 N Tin / (η Ppeak), N b / BW) + thead + tnet

模型算一次的时间，大约是两者中较大的那个：把输入的 Tin 个词元算一遍要的运算除以实际算力，和把参数读一遍的时间；再加上出动作那一小部分的时间，和（如果放在云上）网络来回的时间。The time for one call of the model is roughly the larger of two things: the operations needed to run the Tin input tokens through once, divided by the compute actually achieved, and the time to read all the parameters once; plus the time for the small part that produces the actions, and (if it runs in the cloud) the network round trip.

动作模型每次要看几张图、几句话，几百个词元一起进去，是预填充（第 ⑦ 步）：一份参数用几百次，往往卡在算力上；出动作的那一小部分要反复算几步，又常常卡在读参数上。放在云上，算得快多了，可要加上网络来回的时间，而且这段时间忽长忽短。Each time, the action model looks at a few images and a few sentences: a few hundred tokens go in together, which is prefill (step ⑦). Each parameter fetched is used a few hundred times, so this part is often limited by compute; the small part that produces the actions has to run several steps over and over, and is often limited by reading the parameters. In the cloud the computing is much faster, but the network round trip has to be added, and that time is long one moment and short the next.

tcall
模型算一次、交出一块动作的时间time for the model to run once and hand over one chunk of actions
N, b
参数个数；每个参数几字节number of parameters; bytes per parameter
Tin
一次输入的词元数（几张图的词元加上文字和机器人的状态）tokens input per call (the tokens of a few images, plus the text and the robot’s state)
η
实际能用上的算力占峰值的比例（常常只有一半上下，这里是假设）the fraction of peak compute actually achieved (often only around a half; assumed here)
Ppeak, BW
芯片的峰值算力；内存带宽the chip’s peak compute; memory bandwidth
thead, tnet
生成动作那部分的时间；网络来回的时间time for the part that generates the actions; network round-trip time

机器人的动作模型约 30 亿参数、用 FP8 存：读一遍参数 3 GB / 273 GB/s ≈ 11 ms，这是下限。三张图共 768 个词元，加上文字和状态，Tin ≈ 800，预填充约 2 × 3 × 109 × 800 = 4.8 × 1012 次运算；它在 Thor 上要多久，取决于稠密 FP8 的实际算力，NVIDIA 没有公布这个峰值。假设稠密是稀疏的一半、FP8 是 FP4 的一半（517.5 TFLOPS），再取 η = 0.5，预填充约 18.6 ms；出动作的那部分像 π0 一样是一个 3 亿参数的小模型，要算 10 步，每步把它的参数读一遍，10 × 0.3 GB / 273 GB/s ≈ 11 ms；合起来约 30 ms。这个式子只算了矩阵乘法和读参数，η 和峰值又是假设的，所以只是一个偏乐观的估计；光读参数的那两段（约 22 ms）才是真正的下限。看一个实测：NVIDIA 把一个 30 亿参数的动作模型（GR00T N1.7）放在 Thor 上，用 FP8 算一次 44 ms，换成大部分 NVFP4 是 39.9 ms，每秒 25 次（NVIDIA 2026），跟得上每秒 10 次的节拍。π0 在一块台式机显卡（RTX 4090）上算一次 73 ms；放到机器外面、经 Wi-Fi 多出 13 ms（Black 等 2024）。The robot’s action model has about 3 billion parameters, stored in FP8: reading the parameters once takes 3 GB / 273 GB/s ≈ 11 ms, and that is the floor. Three images make 768 tokens; with the text and the state, Tin ≈ 800, so prefill is about 2 × 3 × 109 × 800 = 4.8 × 1012 operations. How long that takes on Thor depends on its actual dense FP8 compute, and NVIDIA has not published that peak. Assume dense is half of sparse and FP8 half of FP4 (517.5 TFLOPS), and take η = 0.5: prefill then takes about 18.6 ms. The part that produces the actions is, as in π0, a small model of 300 million parameters that runs 10 steps, reading its parameters once per step: 10 × 0.3 GB / 273 GB/s ≈ 11 ms. Together, about 30 ms. This formula counts only the matrix multiplications and the parameter reads, and η and the peak are assumptions, so it is only a somewhat optimistic estimate; only the two parameter-reading parts (about 22 ms) are a true floor. Now a measurement: NVIDIA ran a 3-billion-parameter action model (GR00T N1.7) on Thor, and one call took 44 ms in FP8 and 39.9 ms with most of it switched to NVFP4, 25 calls a second (NVIDIA 2026), so it keeps up with a beat of 10 times a second. π0 takes 73 ms per call on a desktop graphics card (RTX 4090); run off the robot over Wi-Fi, it takes 13 ms more (Black et al. 2024).

"来得及"有两层意思：平均要够快，最慢的那一次也要够快。网络偶尔卡 300 ms，平均再快也没用，所以要紧的环必须放在身上。"Keep up" means two things: fast enough on average, and fast enough on the slowest call as well. If the network now and then stalls for 300 ms, no average speed will help, so the loops that matter must run on the robot itself.

要一个"会想的"机器人，需要什么What it takes to have a robot that "thinks"

如果想让机器人用一个大得多的模型，一边看一边想、每秒想十次，还要把想法说出来（生成词元），要求会陡增。生成是逐词的、凑不成批，所以带宽是最紧的那一条：If we want the robot to use a much bigger model that thinks while it watches, ten times a second, and also says its thoughts out loud (generating tokens), the demands shoot up. Generation goes token by token and can’t be batched, so bandwidth is the tightest constraint:

BW ≥ r · N · bPpeak ≥ 2 N Tin fcall / η

每秒要生成 r 个词元，内存带宽至少是 r 乘模型的字节数；每秒要把 Tin 个新词元想 fcall 次，芯片的峰值算力至少是 2 乘参数个数乘 Tin 乘 fcall，再除以能用上的比例。To generate r tokens a second, the memory bandwidth must be at least r times the model’s size in bytes; to think over Tin new tokens fcall times a second, the chip’s peak compute must be at least 2 times the number of parameters times Tin times fcall, divided by the fraction that can actually be used.

两行分别是第 ③ 步和第 ⑦ 步那两个上限反过来用：给定想要的速度，倒推芯片至少要多快。The two lines are the two limits from steps ③ and ⑦ used in reverse: given the speed you want, work back to the least the chip must deliver.

r
每秒要生成的词元数tokens to generate per second
fcall
每秒想几次how many times a second it thinks

一个 700 亿参数、用 FP4 存（35 GB）的模型，每秒想 10 次、每次看 1000 个新词元、说 5 个词元（每秒 50 个）：带宽至少 50 × 35 GB = 1.75 TB/s，是 Thor 的 273 GB/s 的六倍多；峰值算力至少 2 × 7 × 1010 × 1000 × 10 / 0.5 ≈ 2.8 PFLOPS（这里假设 η = 0.5）。一块 B200 够了：FP4 稠密 9 PFLOPS、约 8 TB/s，可它一块就要 1000 W（Lenovo 2025），是 Thor 上限的 7 倍多，机器人带不动。A 70-billion-parameter model stored in FP4 (35 GB), thinking 10 times a second, each time taking in 1000 new tokens and saying 5 tokens (50 a second): the bandwidth must be at least 50 × 35 GB = 1.75 TB/s, more than six times Thor’s 273 GB/s; the peak compute at least 2 × 7 × 1010 × 1000 × 10 / 0.5 ≈ 2.8 PFLOPS (assuming η = 0.5 here). One B200 would be enough: 9 PFLOPS dense in FP4 and about 8 TB/s, but a single one draws 1000 W (Lenovo 2025), more than 7 times Thor’s maximum, and the robot can’t carry that.

所以对具身智能来说，最缺的不是"峰值算力"，而是"每瓦能搬多少字节"：把 HBM 那样的带宽装进一百瓦里。这正是第 ⑭、⑮ 步里那些新技术要解决的问题。So what embodied AI lacks most is not "peak compute" but "how many bytes it can move per watt": fitting HBM-class bandwidth into a hundred watts. That is exactly the problem the new technologies in steps ⑭ and ⑮ set out to solve.

  • 选模型、精度、每次看几张图、每秒算几次、每次说几个词元，再选在哪跑：Orin、Thor（机器人上），或云端 B200（加上网络来回，拖滑块改延迟）。Choose the model, the precision, how many images it sees per call, how many calls a second and how many tokens it says per call; then choose where it runs: Orin or Thor (on the robot), or a cloud B200 (this adds the network round trip; drag the slider to change the latency).
  • 下面是一次计算的时间分解，和它能不能跟上要求的节拍；还有内存够不够、模块忙了百分之几、耗多少电。最后一行说卡在哪：算力、带宽、容量，还是网络。Below is the time for one call, broken down, and whether it keeps up with the required period; also whether the memory is big enough, what percentage of the time the module is busy, and how much power it uses. The last line says what limits it: compute, bandwidth, capacity or the network.
  • 几个预设：像 π0 那样的动作模型、像 Helix 那样的快慢两系统、问云端的大模型、未来：身上跑 70B。A few presets: An action model like π0, Fast and slow systems like Helix, Ask a large model in the cloud and Future: 70B on board.

先玩：先选"像 π0 那样的动作模型"：在 Thor 上算一次多久，跟得上吗？把精度从 FP8 换成 FP4 呢？再选"问云端的大模型"，把网络延迟拖到 200 ms。最后看"未来"那个预设：差了几倍，卡在哪？Try first: start with "An action model like π0": how long does one call take on Thor, and does it keep up? What if you switch the precision from FP8 to FP4? Then choose "Ask a large model in the cloud" and drag the network latency to 200 ms. Finally, look at the "Future" preset: by what factor does it fall short, and what limits it?

这一步的要点：具身智能要看得多、来得及、记得住、带得动、不掉线。今天的办法是快慢两个系统加上一次出一整块动作，最快的反应交给控制环。要让机器人在身上实时地用大模型思考，缺的主要是每瓦的内存带宽。The point of this step: embodied AI has to see a lot, keep up, remember, carry the load and not drop out. Today’s answer is fast and slow systems plus a whole chunk of actions at a time, with the fastest reactions left to the control loops. For a robot to think with a large model on board, in real time, what is mainly missing is memory bandwidth per watt.

第 ⑬ 步 · 机器人身体里的计算机Step ⑬ · The computer inside the robot

六层和一级级的环，落在哪块芯片上Where the six layers and the nested loops land, chip by chip

现在可以把这台机器人的计算机整个画出来了。它不是一台电脑，而是几十块芯片，按第 5 篇的两把尺子分工：六层（传感、感知与估计、决策、规划、控制、执行）是一个环里信息要经过的工序，几级环是一个套一个、越往里越快的节拍。越快、越要准时的环，越靠近电机，用越小、越确定的芯片；越慢、越需要"想"的事，越往上放，用越大的芯片，甚至放到云上。Now we can draw this robot’s whole computer. It is not one computer but dozens of chips, dividing the work by page 5’s two yardsticks: the six layers (sensing, perception and estimation, decision, planning, control, actuation) are the stages information passes through within one loop, and the levels of loops are beats nested one inside another, faster the further in. The faster a loop and the more it must be on time, the closer it sits to the motors, on smaller and more predictable chips; the slower a job and the more "thinking" it needs, the higher up it goes, on bigger chips, even in the cloud.

  • 传感器自己的芯片（传感）：相机的感光芯片，IMU 的微机电结构和读出芯片，关节的编码器，力传感器的模数转换器，麦克风的模数转换器。它们只负责把物理量变成数。The sensors’ own chips (sensing): the cameras’ image sensors, the IMU’s micro-electromechanical structure and readout chip, the joints’ encoders, the force sensors’ analogue-to-digital converters and the microphones’ analogue-to-digital converters. Their only job is to turn physical quantities into numbers.
  • 传感器集线板上的 FPGA（传感）：同时触发四台相机曝光，给相机、IMU、麦克风的每一份数据打上同一个钟的时间戳，当整台机器人的主钟（第 ⑪ 步）。The FPGA on the sensor hub board (sensing): it triggers the four cameras to expose at the same time, stamps every piece of data from the cameras, the IMU and the microphones with a timestamp from the same clock, and serves as the master clock for the whole robot (step ⑪).
  • 主计算模块：一块片上系统，CPU、GPU、ISP（图像信号处理器，把相机的原始数据变成彩色图像，RidgeRun）、视频编解码器做在一起，共用 128 GB 的 LPDDR5X，带宽 273 GB/s，整个模块 40 到 130 W（NVIDIA 2026）。GPU 跑规划模型（决策）、动作模型（规划）和需要神经网络的感知；CPU 核跑 ROS 2 的程序、状态估计（感知与估计）；单独隔出几个核、跑实时系统，每毫秒算一次全身控制（控制）。The main compute module: one system on chip that combines the CPU, the GPU, an ISP (image signal processor, which turns the cameras’ raw data into colour images, RidgeRun) and video codecs, all sharing 128 GB of LPDDR5X with a bandwidth of 273 GB/s; the whole module draws 40 to 130 W (NVIDIA 2026). The GPU runs the planner (decision), the action model (planning) and the perception that needs neural networks; the CPU cores run the ROS 2 programs and state estimation (perception and estimation); a few cores, set apart to run a real-time system, compute whole-body control once every millisecond (control).
  • EtherCAT 总线：每毫秒一帧，把 21 个关节的目标送下去、把角度和电流收上来（第 5 篇第 ⑩ 步）。The EtherCAT bus: one frame every millisecond, carrying targets down to the 21 joints and bringing angles and currents back up (step ⑩ of page 5).
  • 21 个关节驱动器：每个里面一块单片机，跑位置、速度、电流三级环，电流环每秒两万次（控制）；它驱动一组功率管，把电池的电压一下一下接到电机上（执行）。21 joint drivers: each has a microcontroller inside, running three nested loops for position, velocity and current, with the current loop at 20,000 times a second (control); it drives a set of power transistors that switch the battery’s voltage onto the motor, pulse after pulse (actuation).
  • 安全控制器：一块独立的小芯片，急停按钮按下或者它发现异常，就通过一根硬线让所有驱动器停止出力，不经过任何大模型、任何操作系统。The safety controller: a small, independent chip. When the emergency stop button is pressed, or it detects something wrong, it uses a hard-wired line to make every driver stop producing force, without going through any large model or any operating system.
  • 无线网卡：偶尔把难题发给云端的大模型（第 ⑧ 步）。The wireless card: now and then sends a hard problem to a large model in the cloud (step ⑧).
tloop = tsense + tlink + tcompute + tact

一个环从"测到"到"动起来"的总时间，等于传感器测量和送出的时间，加上线上传输的时间，加上算的时间，再加上执行器跟上的时间。The total time for a loop, from "measured" to "moving", is the time for the sensor to measure and send, plus the time on the wire, plus the time to compute, plus the time for the actuator to follow.

每一级环都要在自己的节拍里转完一圈，第 5 篇第 ③ 步说过，延迟比采样慢更要命。把一个环放在哪块芯片上，就是在给这四项分配时间：越往上，"算"的那一项越长、越不确定；越往下，四项都短而确定。所以反射一样的反应必须走下面的路。Every level of loop has to go round once within its own beat, and, as step ③ of page 5 said, latency does more harm than slow sampling. Choosing which chip a loop runs on means sharing out time among these four terms: the higher up, the longer and less predictable the "compute" term; the lower down, the shorter and more predictable all four are. So reflex-like reactions have to take the path lower down.

tloop
一个环转一圈的延迟latency of one trip round a loop
tsense, tlink
测量（包括相机曝光、读出）的时间；在线上走的时间time to measure (including camera exposure and readout); time on the wire
tcompute, tact
算的时间；电机、夹爪真正动起来的时间time to compute; time until the motor or gripper actually moves

④ 递水的那一下：腕部力传感器每 1 ms 测一次，EtherCAT 下一帧（≤ 1 ms）把读数送到实时核，全身控制在这一毫秒里判断"被拉了"、下令松开，下一帧送到夹爪的单片机，电流环在几十微秒内改变电流，握力随即松下来，夹爪再过几毫秒开始张开（张到底要几十到几百毫秒）：从你一拉到夹爪开始张开，几毫秒。要是这件事交给动作模型：等它下一次看相机（最多 100 ms），再算几十毫秒；交给云端，还要加上几十到几百毫秒的网络。④ The moment of handing over the water: the wrist force/torque sensor measures every 1 ms; the next EtherCAT frame (≤ 1 ms) carries the reading to the real-time cores; within that millisecond, whole-body control decides "it’s being pulled" and orders a release; the next frame carries the order to the gripper’s microcontroller; the current loop changes the current within tens of microseconds, the grip slackens at once, and a few milliseconds later the gripper starts to open (opening fully takes tens to hundreds of milliseconds): from your pull to the gripper starting to open, a few milliseconds. If this were left to the action model, it would wait for its next look at the cameras (up to 100 ms), then compute for tens of milliseconds; leave it to the cloud, and tens to hundreds of milliseconds of network come on top.

所以大模型并没有"接管"机器人：它管的是慢的那几级环里的决策和规划；准时的那几级，还是靠第 5 篇里那些不起眼的芯片和控制器。So the large model has not "taken over" the robot: it handles decision and planning in the slower levels of loops; the levels that must be on time still rely on the humble chips and controllers of page 5.

  • 这是机器人的计算机框图：左边是传感器，中间是 FPGA 和主计算模块，右边是总线、21 个关节驱动器和电机（手机上画在最下面），上面是安全控制器和通往云端的网络。线上写着用的是什么接口。This is a block diagram of the robot’s computer: sensors on the left, the FPGA and the main compute module in the middle, and on the right the bus, the 21 joint drivers and the motors (on a phone, drawn at the bottom); along the top, the safety controller and the network to the cloud. The lines are labelled with the interfaces they use.
  • 按六层上色：每个方块的颜色是它属于哪一层。按时钟上色：每个各自走的钟（大多是一个晶振）一种颜色，看看一台机器人里有多少个，哪些线负责把它们对齐。Colour by layer: each block’s colour shows which layer it belongs to. Colour by clock: each independent clock (mostly a crystal) gets a colour of its own; see how many there are in one robot, and which lines are responsible for aligning them.
  • 点一个方块，下面写出它做什么、每秒几次、用的什么芯片和接口、延迟和功耗。Tap a block and the text below says what it does, how many times a second, which chip and interface it uses, and its latency and power.

先玩：先按六层上色：哪一层用的芯片最多？换成按时钟上色：一共有几个钟？再点力传感器和夹爪：递水时的那一下反应，走的是哪几块芯片？Try first: start by colouring by layer: which layer uses the most chips? Switch to colouring by clock: how many clocks are there in all? Then tap the force sensors and the grippers: which chips does the reaction at the moment of handing over the water pass through?

这一步的要点：一台机器人的计算机是几十块芯片：传感器自己的芯片把物理量变成数，FPGA 管时间，主计算模块的 GPU 跑大模型、CPU 跑程序和实时控制，关节里的单片机跑最快的电流环，安全控制器有自己的硬线。越快、越要准时的环，越靠近电机。The point of this step: a robot’s computer is dozens of chips: the sensors’ own chips turn physical quantities into numbers, the FPGA keeps time, the main compute module’s GPU runs the large models and its CPU the programs and real-time control, the microcontrollers in the joints run the fastest loops, the current loops, and the safety controller has its own hard wire. The faster a loop and the more it must be on time, the closer it sits to the motors.

第 ⑭ 步 · 前沿Step ⑭ · The frontier

芯片往哪走：晶体管、封装、内存、数字格式、连线和电Where chips are going: transistors, packaging, memory, number formats, links and power

CPU、GPU、专用芯片、FPGA、单片机、相机和 IMU 里的芯片，长相和用途各不相同（第 ⑤ 步），可它们出自同一条制造链：同样的晶圆厂、同样的晶体管、同样的封装办法。所以"前沿"有一半是大家共有的：晶体管怎么再缩小、芯片怎么拼得更大、内存怎么离运算更近。另一半是 AI 芯片自己逼出来的：更窄的数字、更快的连线、一柜一兆瓦的电。下面按第 ① 到第 ⑨ 步的顺序走一遍。CPUs, GPUs, accelerators, FPGAs, microcontrollers and the chips inside cameras and IMUs look different and do different jobs (step ⑤), but they all come out of the same manufacturing chain: the same wafer fabs, the same transistors, the same ways of packaging. So half of the "frontier" is shared by them all: how to shrink transistors further, how to join chips into bigger ones, how to bring memory closer to the arithmetic. The other half is forced by AI chips themselves: narrower numbers, faster links, a megawatt of power per rack. Below, we go through it in the order of steps ① to ⑨.

晶体管：栅极把沟道整个包住，电线挪到背面Transistors: the gate wraps right round the channel, and the power wires move to the back

第 ① 步说过，晶体管缩到一定程度以后，漏电让电压降不下去，时钟也就停在了几 GHz。对付漏电的办法，是让控制电流的栅极把导电的沟道包得更严：十几年前的 FinFET 从三面包住一片竖着的"鳍"；现在的全环绕栅极（GAA）把几片叠起来的薄片四面都包住。台积电的 2 nm 工艺（N2）是它第一代用这种"纳米片"晶体管的工艺，2025 年第四季度开始量产；和上一代 3 nm 相比，同样的功耗快 10% 到 15%，或者同样的速度省电 25% 到 30%（TechSpot 2026）。Intel 的 18A 同样换了全环绕栅极（它叫 RibbonFET），还把供电的线挪到了晶圆背面（PowerVia），2026 年 1 月随笔记本处理器上市（GamingOnLinux 2025）；台积电带背面供电的 A16 计划 2026 年下半年量产。背面供电的好处是：供电和信号不再挤在同一面抢地方，电压掉得少，布线也更宽松。Step ① said that once transistors shrink past a certain point, leakage stops the voltage from coming down, and so clocks stalled at a few GHz. The cure for leakage is to make the gate, which controls the current, wrap the conducting channel more tightly: the FinFET of a decade or so ago grips an upright "fin" on three sides; today’s gate-all-around (GAA) transistor wraps several stacked thin sheets on all four sides. TSMC’s 2 nm process (N2) is its first to use these "nanosheet" transistors, and it entered volume production in the fourth quarter of 2025; compared with the previous 3 nm generation, it is 10% to 15% faster at the same power, or uses 25% to 30% less power at the same speed (TechSpot 2026). Intel’s 18A has also switched to gate-all-around (Intel calls it RibbonFET) and has moved the power wiring to the back of the wafer as well (PowerVia); it went on sale in laptop processors in January 2026 (GamingOnLinux 2025). TSMC’s A16, with backside power, is planned for volume production in the second half of 2026. The benefit of backside power: power and signals no longer crowd onto the same side fighting for room, less voltage is lost, and the wiring has more space.

刻得更细，要更短波长、更大口径的光刻机。ASML 第一台用于量产的高数值孔径 EUV 光刻机（EXE:5200B）2025 年 7 月交付，Intel 计划在 2027 到 2028 年的 14A 工艺上用它（Bits&Chips 2025）。代价是一次曝光能印的面积减半：第 ① 步说的 26 mm × 33 mm 变成 26 mm × 16.5 mm，约 429 mm²。单块芯片更难做大，这又把大家推向下一节。Printing finer features takes lithography machines with a shorter wavelength and a larger aperture. ASML delivered its first high-numerical-aperture EUV lithography machine for volume production (EXE:5200B) in July 2025, and Intel plans to use it for its 14A process in 2027 to 2028 (Bits&Chips 2025). The price is that the area one exposure can print is halved: the 26 mm × 33 mm of step ① becomes 26 mm × 16.5 mm, about 429 mm². A single chip becomes even harder to make large, which pushes everyone towards the next section.

封装：一块芯片做不大，就拼起来Packaging: if one chip can’t be made bigger, join several

一次曝光最多印 858 mm²，一块只靠一次曝光印出来的芯片，面积就到此为止（Cerebras 用跨曝光区的连线把整片晶圆做成一块芯片，是少见的例外，第 ⑥ 步）。AI 芯片早就顶到了：B200 就是两块顶格大小的芯片，靠一条每秒 10 TB 的片间连线拼成一块 GPU（第 ① 步）。往下走，就是把更多小芯片（叫芯粒）和 HBM 一起放在一块硅中介层上：台积电的 CoWoS 中介层已经有约 3.3 个曝光面积大，按行业媒体的报道，计划到 2027 年做到 9 倍（3D InCites 2024）。芯粒之间怎么说话也在标准化：UCIe 是"一个封装里芯粒之间连线"的开放标准，2025 年 8 月的 3.0 版把速度提到每根线每秒 64 G 次传输，AMD、Arm、Google、Intel、Meta、微软、NVIDIA、高通、三星、台积电都在里面（UCIe 2025）。这样，以后一块"芯片"可能是几家公司的芯粒拼在一起。One exposure prints at most 858 mm², and a chip printed in a single exposure can be no larger than that (Cerebras, which makes a whole wafer into one chip with wiring that crosses between exposure fields, is a rare exception; step ⑥). AI chips hit this limit long ago: a B200 is simply two chips of the maximum size, joined into one GPU by a chip-to-chip link that carries 10 TB a second (step ①). The next move is to put more small chips (called chiplets) together with HBM on one silicon interposer: TSMC’s CoWoS interposer is already about 3.3 times the area of one exposure, and according to trade press reports it is planned to reach 9 times by 2027 (3D InCites 2024). How chiplets talk to each other is being standardised too: UCIe is the open standard for "links between chiplets inside one package"; version 3.0, in August 2025, raised the speed to 64 G transfers per second on each wire, and AMD, Arm, Google, Intel, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Samsung and TSMC are all members (UCIe 2025). So in future, one "chip" may be chiplets from several companies put together.

内存：更宽，更高，更近Memory: wider, taller, closer

第 ③ 步的结论是：大模型逐词生成时，速度主要由内存带宽决定。带宽从哪来，可以拆成两个旋钮：Step ③ concluded that when a large model generates token by token, its speed is set mainly by memory bandwidth. Where that bandwidth comes from can be split into two knobs:

BW = w · f / 8

内存的带宽，等于数据线的根数乘每根线每秒传几个比特，再除以 8 换成字节。Memory bandwidth is the number of data lines times the bits each line carries per second, divided by 8 to turn bits into bytes.

要快，要么加线，要么让每根线跑得更快。让一根线跑得更快很难：频率越高，信号衰减和串扰越厉害，每个比特花的电也越多。加线也难：一块电路板上拉不出上千根线。HBM 选了"加线"：几层 DRAM 叠在一起，上下用硅通孔连通，再放在 GPU 旁边同一块硅中介层上，线之间只隔几十微米，于是能拉出 2048 根。这就是 HBM 必须紧挨着 GPU、必须用先进封装的原因。To go faster, you either add lines or make each line run faster. Making one line faster is hard: the higher the frequency, the worse the signal loss and crosstalk, and the more energy each bit costs. Adding lines is hard too: you cannot run over a thousand wires across a circuit board. HBM chose "more lines": several layers of DRAM are stacked and connected top to bottom by through-silicon vias, then placed beside the GPU on the same silicon interposer, where the wires are only tens of micrometres apart, so 2048 of them fit. That is why HBM has to sit right next to the GPU and needs advanced packaging.

BW
带宽，字节/秒（1 GB = 109 字节）bandwidth, in bytes per second (1 GB = 109 bytes)
w
数据线的根数，也叫位宽the number of data lines, also called the bus width
f
每根线每秒传的比特数，Gb/sthe bits each line carries per second, in Gb/s

2025 年 4 月定下的 HBM4 标准：w = 2048，f 最高 8 Gb/s，一叠最多 16 层、64 GB（JEDEC 2025），BW = 2048 × 8 / 8 = 2048 GB/s，约 2 TB/s。2026 年 2 月三星开始出货的 HBM4 跑到 f = 11.7 Gb/s（The Register 2026），一叠 2048 × 11.7 / 8 ≈ 3.0 TB/s。机器人的主计算模块用 LPDDR5X：w = 256，BW = 273 GB/s（NVIDIA 2026），倒推每根线 f = 273 × 8 / 256 ≈ 8.5 Gb/s。每根线只比 HBM4 慢三成，一叠 HBM4 的带宽却是它的 11 倍：差别几乎全在线的根数（2048 对 256）。The HBM4 standard agreed in April 2025: w = 2048, f up to 8 Gb/s, up to 16 layers and 64 GB per stack (JEDEC 2025), so BW = 2048 × 8 / 8 = 2048 GB/s, about 2 TB/s. The HBM4 that Samsung began shipping in February 2026 runs at f = 11.7 Gb/s (The Register 2026), so one stack gives 2048 × 11.7 / 8 ≈ 3.0 TB/s. The robot’s main compute module uses LPDDR5X: w = 256, BW = 273 GB/s (NVIDIA 2026); working back, each line runs at f = 273 × 8 / 256 ≈ 8.5 Gb/s. Each line is only about 30% slower than HBM4’s, yet one HBM4 stack has 11 times the bandwidth: almost all of the difference is in the number of lines (2048 against 256).

所以给机器人"装上 HBM"不只是钱的问题：HBM 要和芯片一起做在中介层上，贵、热，还要和 GPU 同时设计。机器人想要数据中心那样的带宽，要么等这类封装变便宜、变省电，要么换个思路，不把数搬来搬去（第 ⑮ 步）。So "giving the robot HBM" is not just a question of money: HBM has to be built onto the interposer together with the chip, which is expensive and runs hot, and it has to be designed together with the GPU. If a robot wants data-centre bandwidth, it must either wait for this kind of packaging to become cheaper and use less power, or think differently and stop moving numbers back and forth (step ⑮).

数据中心的 GPU 在三个方向上同时加码：更宽更快（HBM4）、更高（一叠 12 到 16 层）、更多叠（一块 GPU 周围放更多叠）。NVIDIA 的 Rubin GPU 用 288 GB HBM4（NVIDIA 2026），AMD 的 MI450 用 432 GB HBM4、19.6 TB/s（Tom’s Hardware 2025）：容量分别是 B200（约 180 GB）的 1.6 倍和 2.4 倍，MI450 的带宽是它的约 2.5 倍。下一步是在 HBM 最底下那层"基础芯片"里放进逻辑电路，让内存自己做一点事，这已经走到第 ⑮ 步的门口了。Data-centre GPUs are pushing in three directions at once: wider and faster (HBM4), taller (12 to 16 layers per stack) and more stacks (more of them around each GPU). NVIDIA’s Rubin GPU uses 288 GB of HBM4 (NVIDIA 2026) and AMD’s MI450 uses 432 GB of HBM4 at 19.6 TB/s (Tom’s Hardware 2025), that is 1.6 and 2.4 times the capacity of a B200 (about 180 GB), and the MI450 has about 2.5 times its bandwidth. The next step is to put logic circuits into the "base die" at the very bottom of the HBM stack, so that the memory can do a little work itself, and that already brings us to the doorstep of step ⑮.

数字格式：每个数再少几位Number formats: a few bits fewer for every number

第 ④ 步讲过，每个数少用一半的位，存的字节、搬的字节都减半，乘法器还小得更多（大小大致和尾数位数的平方成正比）。B200 上，BF16、FP8、FP4 的稠密峰值分别是 2.25、4.5、9 PFLOPS（NVIDIA）：每砍一半位数，算力翻一倍。难处是 4 位只能表示 16 个值，误差很大。现在的办法是分块缩放：每 16 个数共用一个 8 位的缩放因子，整个张量再共用一个，NVIDIA 叫它 NVFP4。它比 FP16 小约 3.5 倍、比 FP8 小约 1.8 倍；把 DeepSeek-R1 从 FP8 换成 NVFP4，关键语言任务上准确率只掉 1% 或更少（NVIDIA 2025）。开放的 OCP 微缩放格式（MX）用的是同样的思路，每 32 个数一组（OCP 2023）。机器人上也一样：一个 30 亿参数的动作模型在 Jetson Thor 上，用 PyTorch 直接跑 BF16，算一次要 126 ms；用 TensorRT 优化以后，BF16 是 81 ms，FP8 是 44 ms，大部分换成 NVFP4 是 39.9 ms，每秒 25 次（NVIDIA 2026）。Step ④ showed that using half as many bits per number halves the bytes stored and the bytes moved, and shrinks the multipliers even more (their size goes roughly with the square of the number of mantissa bits). On the B200, the dense peaks for BF16, FP8 and FP4 are 2.25, 4.5 and 9 PFLOPS (NVIDIA): every time the bits are halved, the compute doubles. The difficulty is that 4 bits can represent only 16 values, so the errors are large. Today’s answer is block scaling: every 16 numbers share one 8-bit scale factor, and the whole tensor shares one more; NVIDIA calls this NVFP4. It is about 3.5 times smaller than FP16 and about 1.8 times smaller than FP8, and moving DeepSeek-R1 from FP8 to NVFP4 cost only 1% or less in accuracy on key language tasks (NVIDIA 2025). The open OCP Microscaling (MX) formats use the same idea, with groups of 32 numbers (OCP 2023). The robot is no different: a 3-billion-parameter action model on Jetson Thor takes 126 ms per call when run directly in PyTorch in BF16; after optimisation with TensorRT it takes 81 ms in BF16, 44 ms in FP8 and 39.9 ms with most of it switched to NVFP4, 25 calls a second (NVIDIA 2026).

连线：更快的 NVLink，光走进交换机Links: faster NVLink, and light moves into the switch

每块 GPU 的 NVLink 带宽（两个方向合计），Blackwell 是 1.8 TB/s，Rubin 是 3 TB/s；一柜 72 块 GPU 合起来从 130 TB/s 到 216 TB/s（NVIDIA 2026）。机柜之间还得靠光（第 ⑨ 步），而光模块本身已经是一笔大电费：按 OPN 对 NVIDIA 这次发布的报道，一座 AI 工厂可能要 240 万个光模块、24 MW 的电，可能超过整个数据中心用电的一成（OPN 2025），平均每个约 10 W。于是把光收发器直接做进交换芯片的封装里，省掉中间那段又长又费电的电线，叫共封装光学。NVIDIA 2025 年 3 月发布了这样的交换机，说能把功率效率提高到 3.5 倍；InfiniBand 版原计划 2025 年晚些时候推出、以太网版 2026 年（OPN 2025）；InfiniBand 版到 2026 年年中才把第一批工程样机交到 Lambda 这样的客户手里（Lambda 2026）。再往前一步，是把光直接接到 GPU 和内存上（第 ⑮ 步）。NVLink bandwidth per GPU (both directions added) is 1.8 TB/s for Blackwell and 3 TB/s for Rubin; a rack of 72 GPUs together goes from 130 TB/s to 216 TB/s (NVIDIA 2026). Between racks you still need light (step ⑨), and the optical transceivers themselves are already a big power bill: according to OPN’s report on NVIDIA’s announcement, an AI factory may need 2.4 million optical transceivers drawing 24 MW, possibly more than a tenth of all the power the data centre uses (OPN 2025), about 10 W each on average. Hence the idea of building the optical transceivers straight into the switch chip’s package, cutting out the long, power-hungry stretch of electrical wire in between; this is called co-packaged optics. NVIDIA announced such switches in March 2025, saying they give 3.5 times the power efficiency; the InfiniBand version was originally due later in 2025 and the Ethernet version in 2026 (OPN 2025); it was mid-2026 before the InfiniBand version’s first engineering samples reached customers such as Lambda (Lambda 2026). One step further is to connect light directly to GPUs and memory (step ⑮).

电和热：一柜一兆瓦Power and heat: a megawatt per rack

一个 GB200 NVL72 机柜按 132 kW 设计供电和散热（Vertiv 2024）。NVIDIA 说，机柜里现在用的 54 V 供电，到每柜 200 kW 左右就到了物理极限，计划从 2027 年起改用 800 V 直流，给一柜一兆瓦的系统供电（NVIDIA 2025）。风已经吹不动这么多热，芯片要直接用液体冷却；Rubin 的八卡服务器标的进水温度是 45 °C（NVIDIA）：进水可以这么热，就不必专门把水冷下来，省下冷水机的电。A GB200 NVL72 rack is designed for 132 kW of power and cooling (Vertiv 2024). NVIDIA says the 54 V supply used inside racks today reaches its physical limits at around 200 kW per rack, and it plans to switch to 800 V DC from 2027 to power systems of a megawatt per rack (NVIDIA 2025). Air can no longer carry away this much heat, so the chips must be cooled directly with liquid; Rubin’s 8-GPU server is rated for an inlet water temperature of 45 °C (NVIDIA): if the incoming water can be this warm, there is no need to chill it specially, which saves the power of the chillers.

专用芯片和机器人芯片Accelerators and robot chips

第 ⑥ 步的那些对手也都在往前走。Google 第 7 代 TPU（Ironwood）一个 pod 连 9216 块芯片（Google Cloud）；亚马逊的 Trainium3 是它第一款 3 nm 的 AI 芯片（AWS 2025）；AMD 的 Helios 机柜放 72 块 MI450，甲骨文计划从 2026 年第三季度起部署约 5 万块（Tom’s Hardware 2025）。机器人这一端，NVIDIA 的 Jetson Thor 2025 年 8 月上市（NVIDIA 2025），标的是 FP4 稀疏 2070 TFLOPS、128 GB 内存、最多 130 W（NVIDIA 2026），1X 的家用人形机器人 NEO 就用它（1X）；高通的 Dragonwing IQ10 瞄准人形机器人，参考设计标称 700 TOPS（精度没说），2026 年 9 月起供货（Profesional Review 2026）；特斯拉自己的 AI5 2026 年 4 月流片，计划 2027 年用进 Optimus（Not a Tesla App 2026）。和数据中心比，机器人芯片的瓶颈仍然是那一条：几百 GB/s 的内存带宽，要在一百瓦里换成更多。The rivals from step ⑥ are all moving forward too. Google’s seventh-generation TPU (Ironwood) links 9216 chips in one pod (Google Cloud); Amazon’s Trainium3 is its first 3 nm AI chip (AWS 2025); AMD’s Helios rack holds 72 MI450s, and Oracle plans to deploy about 50,000 of them from the third quarter of 2026 (Tom’s Hardware 2025). At the robot end, NVIDIA’s Jetson Thor went on sale in August 2025 (NVIDIA 2025), rated at 2070 TFLOPS in sparse FP4, with 128 GB of memory and up to 130 W (NVIDIA 2026), and 1X’s home humanoid robot NEO uses it (1X); Qualcomm’s Dragonwing IQ10 is aimed at humanoid robots, with a reference design rated at 700 TOPS (precision not stated) and supply from September 2026 (Profesional Review 2026); Tesla’s own AI5 taped out in April 2026 and is planned to go into Optimus in 2027 (Not a Tesla App 2026). Compared with the data centre, the robot chip’s bottleneck is still the same one: a few hundred GB/s of memory bandwidth, which needs to grow while staying within a hundred watts.

  • 横轴是年份，纵轴是对数刻度：数据中心 GPU 每一代的峰值算力、显存带宽、NVLink 带宽和显存容量，都除以第一个点，从 ×1 开始，看谁跑得快。The horizontal axis is the year and the vertical axis is a log scale: the peak compute, memory bandwidth, NVLink bandwidth and memory capacity of each generation of data-centre GPU are all divided by the first point so that they start at ×1; see which one grows fastest.
  • 同一精度比：只比 16 位数的稠密算力（BF16；V100 还没有 BF16，用 FP16），看算力的增长里有多少是靠"每个数少用几位"换来的。Same precision: compares only dense compute on 16-bit numbers (BF16; V100 has no BF16 yet, so FP16), to show how much of the growth in compute came from "using fewer bits per number".
  • 下面一小条是机器人模块（Orin、Thor）。点一个点，看它的数字、精度和状态（上市还是只是发布）。The small strip below shows the robot modules (Orin, Thor). Tap a point to see its numbers, precision and status (on sale, or only announced).

先玩：从 V100 到 Rubin，算力涨了多少倍，带宽涨了多少倍？打开"同一精度比"：算力的涨幅还剩多少？再看机器人模块：它的带宽落后数据中心 GPU 多少倍？Try first: from V100 to Rubin, how many times did compute grow, and how many times did bandwidth grow? Switch on "Same precision": how much of the compute growth is left? Then look at the robot modules: by what factor does their bandwidth trail the data-centre GPUs?

这一步的要点：晶体管在换结构（全环绕栅极、背面供电），一块芯片做不大就用芯粒拼；内存靠更多的线变快，所以要紧挨着运算芯片；每个数用的位数在减少；机柜之间开始把光做进交换机；电和散热成了新的上限。机器人最缺的仍是每瓦的内存带宽。The point of this step: transistors are changing their structure (gate-all-around, backside power), and when one chip cannot be made bigger, chiplets are joined together; memory gets faster through more lines, so it has to sit right next to the compute chip; the number of bits per number is shrinking; between racks, light is starting to be built into the switches; power and cooling have become the new ceiling. What robots lack most is still memory bandwidth per watt.

第 ⑮ 步 · 还没落地的路Step ⑮ · Routes not yet in commercial use

谁在试别的路，能解决什么，卡在哪Who is trying other routes, what they could fix, and where they are stuck

前面几步攒下了几个今天的硬伤。内存墙：逐词生成时，算力大多在等内存（第 ③、⑦ 步）。搬数比算数贵：从片外内存搬一个数，比做一次乘法贵上百倍（第 ④ 步）。连线费电：几万块 GPU 之间的光模块，加起来就是兆瓦级的电（第 ⑨、⑭ 步）。机器人带不动：身上只有一百瓦上下，却想要数据中心那样的内存带宽和反应速度（第 ⑫ 步）。第 ⑥ 步那些已经在卖的芯片，本质上都还是"把数从存储搬到运算单元再算"。下面这几条路想换掉这个做法本身，或者换掉传数据的方式。每一条都按同样的四件事讲：谁在做，长处和它冲着的问题，为什么还没落地，对厨房里那台机器人意味着什么。The earlier steps have piled up a few of today’s hard limits. The memory wall: in token-by-token generation, the compute spends most of its time waiting for memory (steps ③ and ⑦). Moving data costs more than computing: fetching one number from off-chip memory costs over a hundred times as much as one multiplication (step ④). Links eat power: the optical transceivers between tens of thousands of GPUs add up to megawatts (steps ⑨ and ⑭). The robot can’t carry it: it has only about a hundred watts on board, yet wants data-centre memory bandwidth and reaction speed (step ⑫). The chips from step ⑥ that are already on sale all still, at heart, "move the numbers from memory to the compute units and then compute". The routes below try to replace that way of working itself, or the way data is carried. Each one is covered under the same four points: who is working on it, its strengths and the problem it targets, why it has not yet reached commercial use, and what it means for the robot in the kitchen.

1. 在存储里算：模拟存内计算1. Computing inside the memory: analogue in-memory computing

最彻底的办法是不搬。把每个权重存成一个存储单元的电导 G，把输入变成加在上面的电压 V，流过的电流就是两者的乘积：I = G · V（欧姆定律）。一列上所有单元的电流汇到同一根线上，自己就加在了一起（基尔霍夫电流定律）。于是一整列的乘加一步完成，权重一动不动，这正是神经网络里最多的那种运算。The most radical fix is not to move the data at all. Store each weight as the conductance G of a memory cell and turn the input into a voltage V applied across it: the current that flows is the product of the two, I = G · V (Ohm’s law). The currents from all the cells in a column meet on the same wire and add up by themselves (Kirchhoff’s current law). So a whole column of multiply–accumulates is done in one step while the weights stay exactly where they are, and this is precisely the operation that neural networks do most.

  • 谁在做：IBM 研究院用相变存储（PCM），2023 年在 Nature 上发表了一块 14 nm 的模拟 AI 芯片，34 块阵列，每块 512 × 2048 个单元，跑语音识别和转写（Ambrogio 等 2023）。加州大学圣迭戈分校、斯坦福等的 NeuRRAM 用阻变存储（RRAM），48 个核（Wan 等 2022）。清华大学集成电路学院吴华强、高滨团队做出了能在芯片上自己学习的忆阻器存算一体芯片（China Daily 2023）。从普林斯顿大学分出来的 EnCharge AI，2025 年推出面向笔记本和边缘设备的 EN100（DCD 2025）。Who is working on it: IBM Research, using phase-change memory (PCM), published a 14 nm analogue AI chip in Nature in 2023, with 34 arrays of 512 × 2048 cells each, running speech recognition and transcription (Ambrogio et al. 2023). NeuRRAM, from UC San Diego, Stanford and others, uses resistive memory (RRAM) and has 48 cores (Wan et al. 2022). Wu Huaqiang and Gao Bin’s team at Tsinghua University’s School of Integrated Circuits built a memristor compute-in-memory chip that can learn by itself, on the chip (China Daily 2023). EnCharge AI, a Princeton University spin-out, launched the EN100 for laptops and edge devices in 2025 (DCD 2025).
  • 长处，冲着什么：权重不出存储，直接冲着内存墙和搬数据的能耗。IBM 这块芯片跑语音转写时，实测最高每瓦 12.4 TOPS（五块芯片里最好的一块，输入输出都是 8 位），他们估算整个系统是 6.7 TOPS/W，比 MLPerf 测试里能效最好的提交高 14 倍；转写语音的准确率达到纯软件的 98.1%。清华的芯片在芯片上学习，做同样的学习任务，能耗约为专用数字芯片的 3%。EnCharge 标称 M.2 小卡在 8.25 W 下有 200 多 TOPS。Strengths, and what it targets: The weights never leave the memory, which goes straight at the memory wall and the energy of moving data. When transcribing speech, IBM’s chip reached a measured best of 12.4 TOPS per watt (the best of five chips, with 8-bit inputs and outputs), and the team estimates the whole system at 6.7 TOPS/W, 14 times as efficient as the most efficient submission in the MLPerf benchmarks; it transcribed speech at 98.1% of the accuracy of pure software. Tsinghua’s chip learns on the chip itself, and for the same learning task it uses about 3% of the energy of a dedicated digital chip. EnCharge quotes more than 200 TOPS from a small M.2 card at 8.25 W.
  • 为什么还没落地：模拟量有噪声，能稳定区分的级数不多，模型往往要专门训练或校准，准确率常常比数字计算低一点（上面的 98.1% 就是例子）。输入要从数字变成电压、输出的电流要变回数字，这两次换算的电路占去不少能量和面积。存储单元的电导会随时间漂移，写一次权重又慢又磨损器件，所以大多只做推理、不做训练（清华的芯片是少见的例外）。容量也小：IBM 那块有约 3600 万个相变器件（34 × 512 × 2048），可每个权重要占 2 到 4 个，五块芯片才放下 4500 万个权重；一个 30 亿参数的动作模型要约三百块这样的芯片。新材料要进现有的晶圆厂，配套的编译器和工具也要从头建。Why it has not landed yet: Analogue quantities are noisy and only a few levels can be told apart reliably, so models often need special training or calibration, and accuracy is often a little lower than with digital computing (the 98.1% above is an example). Inputs have to be turned from digital numbers into voltages, and the output currents back into digital numbers, and the circuits for these two conversions take up a good share of the energy and area. The conductance of a memory cell drifts over time, and writing a weight is slow and wears out the device, so most of these chips do only inference, not training (Tsinghua’s chip is a rare exception). Capacity is small too: IBM’s chip has about 36 million phase-change devices (34 × 512 × 2048), but each weight takes 2 to 4 of them, so it took five chips to hold 45 million weights; a 3-billion-parameter action model would need about three hundred such chips. New materials have to get into existing fabs, and the compilers and tools to go with them have to be built from scratch.
  • 对厨房机器人：如果成熟，最有用的地方就在它身上：几瓦就能跑一个中等大小的感知或动作模型，电池撑得更久。For the kitchen robot: If it matures, this is where it would help most: a medium-sized perception or action model running on a few watts, and a battery that lasts longer.

2. 把运算挪到存储旁边：数字近存计算2. Moving the arithmetic next to the memory: digital near-memory computing

不改成模拟，而是把数字运算单元挪到存储旁边，甚至挪进内存芯片里，让数走的路最短。Rather than going analogue, move the digital compute units next to the memory, or even into the memory chips, so that the numbers travel the shortest possible way.

  • 谁在做：三星 2021 年发布 HBM-PIM，在 HBM2 的每个存储库（bank）里放进一个小的 AI 运算单元（Samsung 2021）。IBM 研究院的 NorthPole（2023 年发表在 Science）把全部存储都放在芯片上：12 nm、220 亿个晶体管、800 mm²、256 个核（IBM 2023）。法国的 UPMEM 已经在卖每颗 DRAM 芯片里带 8 个小处理器的内存条，有大学团队专门测过它（Gómez-Luna 等 2021）。第 ⑥ 步的 Groq 和 Cerebras 是这条思路已经商用的近亲：权重全放在片上的 SRAM 里。Who is working on it: In 2021 Samsung announced HBM-PIM, which puts a small AI compute unit in every bank of HBM2 (Samsung 2021). IBM Research’s NorthPole (published in Science in 2023) puts all of its memory on the chip: 12 nm, 22 billion transistors, 800 mm², 256 cores (IBM 2023). France’s UPMEM already sells memory modules with 8 small processors in every DRAM chip, and a university team has benchmarked them in detail (Gómez-Luna et al. 2021). Groq and Cerebras from step ⑥ are commercial relatives of this idea: they keep all the weights in on-chip SRAM.
  • 长处，冲着什么：仍然是数字的，没有模拟噪声；数据走的路短，带宽高、每个比特花的能量少，也是冲着内存墙去。三星说 HBM-PIM 让系统性能提高到两倍多、能耗降低七成以上；IBM 说 NorthPole 在 ResNet-50 图像识别上，每焦耳能处理的图像是同为 12 nm 一代的 GPU 的 25 倍（对 4 nm 的 GPU，IBM 只说仍然领先，没给倍数）。Strengths, and what it targets: It is still digital, so there is no analogue noise; the data travels a short way, so bandwidth is high and each bit costs little energy, and this too goes after the memory wall. Samsung says HBM-PIM more than doubles system performance and cuts energy use by more than 70%; IBM says that on ResNet-50 image recognition, NorthPole processes 25 times as many images per joule as a GPU of the same 12 nm generation (against 4 nm GPUs, IBM says only that it still leads, without giving a factor).
  • 为什么还没落地：DRAM 的工艺是为存储优化的，做出来的晶体管慢，能塞进去的运算单元很简单，只适合"矩阵乘向量"这类事。程序得知道每个数存在哪个存储库里，现有的框架和编译器不认识这种内存，内存厂和芯片厂之间也还没有统一的标准；三星 2021 年公布时，它还在合作伙伴的加速器里测试，今天主流的数据中心 GPU 仍然没有用这类内存。NorthPole 这类全片上的芯片，容量就是芯片上那点存储，大模型要很多块拼起来。NorthPole 本身还是研究原型。Why it has not landed yet: DRAM processes are optimised for storage and make slow transistors, so the compute units that can be squeezed in are simple, suited only to jobs like "matrix times vector". The program has to know which bank each number is stored in, today’s frameworks and compilers do not understand this kind of memory, and there is no common standard yet between memory makers and chip makers; when Samsung announced HBM-PIM in 2021, it was still being tested in partners’ accelerators, and today’s mainstream data-centre GPUs still do not use such memory. For an all-on-chip design like NorthPole, the capacity is just the small amount of memory on the chip, so a large model needs many chips joined together. NorthPole itself is still a research prototype.
  • 对厨房机器人：同样冲着"每瓦的带宽"。要是机器人用的 LPDDR 内存里也能做一点运算，逐词生成时读参数的那一大块，就不必全都搬到 GPU 上去做。For the kitchen robot: It also aims at "bandwidth per watt". If the robot’s LPDDR memory could do a little arithmetic too, the large part of decode that is spent reading parameters would not all have to be moved over to the GPU.

3. 用光来算：光计算3. Computing with light: photonic computing

一束光穿过一组干涉器件时，它的振幅和相位按一个固定的矩阵被重新组合：等光走到另一头，一次矩阵乘向量就做完了，器件本身几乎不耗电，时间就是光走过去的那一点点。When a beam of light passes through a set of interferometers, its amplitude and phase are recombined according to a fixed matrix: by the time the light reaches the far end, a matrix–vector product has been done. The devices themselves use almost no power, and the time taken is just the brief moment the light needs to get through.

  • 谁在做：麻省理工学院 Dirk Englund 和 Marin Soljačić 的团队 2017 年在 Nature Photonics 上用一块硅光芯片跑通了一个小神经网络（Shen 等 2017），随后分出两家公司：同年在波士顿成立的曦智科技（Lightelligence，第一作者沈亦晨创办）（Wikipedia），和三位 MIT 校友创办的 Lightmatter（MIT News 2024）。2025 年这两家各在 Nature 上发表了一块大规模的光子处理器（APS Physics 2025）。清华大学戴琼海、方璐团队 2024 年在 Science 上发表了光子芯粒"太极"（清华大学 2024）。德国 Q.ANT 的光子处理器服务器 2025 年装进莱布尼茨超算中心试用，算是早期产品（All About Circuits 2025）。Who is working on it: In 2017 Dirk Englund and Marin Soljačić’s team at MIT reported in Nature Photonics a small neural network running on a silicon photonic chip (Shen et al. 2017), and two companies then spun out: Lightelligence, founded in Boston the same year by the paper’s first author, Shen Yichen (Wikipedia), and Lightmatter, founded by three MIT alumni (MIT News 2024). In 2025 each of the two published a large-scale photonic processor in Nature (APS Physics 2025). At Tsinghua University, Dai Qionghai and Fang Lu’s team published the photonic chiplet "Taichi" in Science in 2024 (Tsinghua University 2024). In Germany, Q.ANT’s photonic processor server went into trial use at the Leibniz Supercomputing Centre in 2025, which counts as an early product (All About Circuits 2025).
  • 长处，冲着什么：大矩阵乘法的能耗和延迟都可以很低，冲着"算"本身的能耗和延迟。Lightmatter 的处理器不用重新训练，就跑了 ResNet、BERT 和一个玩吃豆人的强化学习程序，精度相当于 7 到 10 位；按论文的实测（每秒 65.5 万亿次运算，用电约 80 W，Hackster 2025），每瓦每秒不到 1 万亿次，还没比 GPU 省电，报道里"能效至少是 GPU 的 10 倍"的说法，测量还撑不起来；曦智的芯片解伊辛模型这类优化问题，比 GPU 快约 500 倍；"太极"标称片上能效 160 TOPS/W。Strengths, and what it targets: Large matrix multiplications can cost very little energy and time, so it is aimed at the energy and latency of the "computing" itself. Without retraining, Lightmatter’s processor ran ResNet, BERT and a reinforcement-learning program that plays Pac-Man, at a precision equivalent to 7 to 10 bits; going by the paper’s measurements (65.5 trillion operations a second, drawing about 80 W, Hackster 2025), that is under 1 trillion operations a second per watt, not yet more efficient than a GPU, so the measurements do not yet support the reported claim of "at least 10 times the energy efficiency of a GPU"; Lightelligence’s chip solves optimisation problems such as Ising models about 500 times faster than a GPU; "Taichi" quotes an on-chip energy efficiency of 160 TOPS/W.
  • 为什么还没落地：光计算是模拟的，噪声把精度限制在 7 到 10 位上下，训练大模型不够。数据要从电变成光、再从光变回电，这两步的能量和延迟会吃掉一大块优势；非线性运算和存储仍然要靠电子电路。光学器件比晶体管大得多，一块芯片上放不下多少个"乘法器"。实际速度也还没到设计值：Lightmatter 那块实测每秒 65.5 万亿次运算，设计目标是 400 万亿次。还要能和现有的框架、内存和服务器接在一起。Why it has not landed yet: Photonic computing is analogue, and noise limits its precision to around 7 to 10 bits, which is not enough for training large models. Data has to be converted from electrical signals into light and back again, and the energy and delay of these two steps eat up much of the advantage; non-linear operations and memory still depend on electronic circuits. Optical devices are much larger than transistors, so a chip cannot hold many "multipliers". Real speeds have not reached the design figures either: Lightmatter’s chip measured 65.5 trillion operations a second against a design target of 400 trillion. It also has to connect to existing frameworks, memory and servers.
  • 对厨房机器人：短期内主要在数据中心；但延迟低这一点，对要快速反应的感知和控制是诱人的。For the kitchen robot: In the near term it will be mostly in data centres; but its low latency is tempting for perception and control that must react quickly.

4. 用光来传：光互连和共封装光学4. Carrying data with light: optical interconnect and co-packaged optics

用光来算还远，用光传数据近得多。问题出在第 ⑨ 步：机柜之间的连线又长又费电，铜线在今天的速度下只能走一两米。Computing with light is still a long way off; carrying data with light is much closer. The problem is the one from step ⑨: the links between racks are long and power-hungry, and at today’s speeds copper can reach only a metre or two.

  • 谁在做：MIT、加州大学伯克利分校和科罗拉多大学的研究者，2015 年在 Nature 上做出第一块直接用光和外界通信的处理器，随后成立 Ayar Labs 做光 I/O 芯粒（MIT News 2018）。Celestial AI 做光互连"光子织物"，2026 年 2 月被 Marvell 收购（Marvell 2026）。Lightmatter 也做光互连 Passage（MIT News 2024）；做光计算起家的曦智科技，据报道已经在中国独立的机柜内光互连市场占到 88.3%（虎嗅 2026）：光传数据比光算数先赚到了钱。NVIDIA 已经推出共封装光学的交换机（第 ⑭ 步）。Who is working on it: In 2015 researchers from MIT, UC Berkeley and the University of Colorado reported in Nature the first processor that communicates with the outside world directly by light, and went on to found Ayar Labs to make optical I/O chiplets (MIT News 2018). Celestial AI makes an optical interconnect, the "Photonic Fabric", and was bought by Marvell in February 2026 (Marvell 2026). Lightmatter also makes an optical interconnect, Passage (MIT News 2024); Lightelligence, which started out in photonic computing, reportedly already holds 88.3% of China’s market for standalone in-rack optical interconnect (Huxiu 2026): carrying data with light has made money before computing with light. NVIDIA has already launched co-packaged-optics switches (step ⑭).
  • 长处，冲着什么：光在光纤里走几十米几乎不衰减，一根光纤里还能并排走几种颜色的光；把光做进封装以后，电信号只需要走几毫米。直接冲着连线的带宽和电费（第 ⑨ 步）。Ayar Labs 2018 年说，芯片之间通信的能耗能降低约 95%、带宽是铜线的 10 倍；NVIDIA 说它的共封装光学交换机功率效率是原来的 3.5 倍（OPN 2025）。Strengths, and what it targets: Light travels tens of metres in an optical fibre with almost no loss, and several colours of light can travel side by side in one fibre; once the optics are built into the package, the electrical signal has to go only a few millimetres. It goes straight at the bandwidth and the electricity bill of the links (step ⑨). In 2018 Ayar Labs said the energy of chip-to-chip communication could fall by about 95%, with 10 times the bandwidth of copper; NVIDIA says its co-packaged-optics switches are 3.5 times as power-efficient as before (OPN 2025).
  • 为什么还没完全落地：激光器是整条链路里最娇气的部件，所以 NVIDIA 的交换机把它留在封装外面，做成能现场更换的外置光源（Lambda 2026）；可封装里的光引擎和光纤接头坏了，不能像插拔式光模块那样单独换，生产、测试和维修的办法都要重新建立。它还要和 GPU、交换芯片一起设计，牵涉好几家公司的接口和标准。它是几条路里离落地最近的：它不改变数是怎么算的，数仍然是数字的，所以没有精度、容量和软件生态这些难处。进度上，交换机这一层 2026 年开始交付第一批客户（年中交出的还是工程样机）；直接接到 GPU 和内存上的光 I/O 还在早期：Marvell 预计 Celestial AI 的收入要到它的 2028 财年下半年才开始。Why it has not fully landed yet: The laser is the most delicate part of the whole link, so NVIDIA’s switches keep it outside the package, as an external light source that can be replaced in the field (Lambda 2026); but if an optical engine or fibre connector inside the package fails, it cannot be swapped on its own the way a pluggable transceiver can, so methods for manufacturing, testing and repair all have to be worked out anew. It also has to be designed together with the GPUs and switch chips, which involves the interfaces and standards of several companies. Of all these routes it is the closest to landing: it does not change how the numbers are computed, and they stay digital, so it avoids the difficulties of precision, capacity and the software ecosystem. As for progress, switches began shipping to their first customers in 2026 (those delivered in mid-year were still engineering samples); optical I/O connected straight to GPUs and memory is still at an early stage: Marvell expects revenue from Celestial AI to start only in the second half of its fiscal year 2028.
  • 对厨房机器人：是间接的：训练和云端大模型更省电、更便宜。For the kitchen robot: The benefit is indirect: training and large cloud models use less power and cost less.

5. 学大脑：神经形态芯片和事件相机5. Learning from the brain: neuromorphic chips and event cameras

大脑不按时钟一拍一拍地算：神经元只在收到足够的刺激时才发一个脉冲，大部分时间是安静的。神经形态芯片学的就是这个：没事发生，就几乎不耗电。事件相机是它在传感器上的版本：每个像素只在自己的亮度变了的时候报一个"事件"，而不是每秒拍 30 张整图。The brain does not compute tick by tick to a clock: a neuron fires a spike only when it receives enough stimulation, and stays quiet most of the time. This is what neuromorphic chips copy: when nothing is happening, they use almost no power. The event camera is the sensor version: each pixel reports an "event" only when its own brightness changes, instead of the camera taking 30 full pictures every second.

  • 谁在做：Intel 的 Loihi 2，2024 年拼成 1152 块芯片、11.5 亿个神经元的 Hala Point，放在桑迪亚国家实验室（Intel 2024）。IBM 和康奈尔大学 2014 年的 TrueNorth（100 万个神经元，跑视频时 63 mW）是 NorthPole 的前身（Merolla 等 2014）。曼彻斯特大学 Steve Furber 的 SpiNNaker 和德累斯顿工业大学 Christian Mayr 的 SpiNNaker2：2025 年在德累斯顿装成 3.5 万块芯片、500 多万个处理器核的 SpiNNcloud，还分出了一家公司（TU Dresden 2025）。清华大学施路平团队的"天机芯"（Nature 2019 封面）同时跑普通神经网络和脉冲网络，一块芯片驾驶了一辆无人自行车（清华大学 2019）。BrainChip 公司 2021 年开始量产神经形态芯片 Akida，算是早期产品（BrainChip 2021）。事件相机这边，法国 Prophesee 和索尼合作的 IMX636 已经是商用的传感器（Prophesee）。Who is working on it: Intel’s Loihi 2: in 2024, 1152 of these chips were combined into Hala Point, with 1.15 billion neurons, housed at Sandia National Laboratories (Intel 2024). TrueNorth, from IBM and Cornell University in 2014 (1 million neurons, 63 mW running video), was the forerunner of NorthPole (Merolla et al. 2014). Steve Furber’s SpiNNaker at the University of Manchester and Christian Mayr’s SpiNNaker2 at TU Dresden: in 2025 SpiNNaker2 was built up in Dresden into SpiNNcloud, with 35,000 chips and more than 5 million processor cores, and a company was spun off (TU Dresden 2025). Shi Luping’s team at Tsinghua University made "Tianjic" (a Nature cover in 2019), which runs ordinary neural networks and spiking networks at the same time; a single chip controlled a driverless bicycle (Tsinghua University 2019). BrainChip began mass production of its neuromorphic chip Akida in 2021, which counts as an early product (BrainChip 2021). On the event-camera side, the IMX636, developed by France’s Prophesee together with Sony, is already a commercial sensor (Prophesee).
  • 长处，冲着什么：功耗随"发生了多少事"变化，冲着机器人的延迟和电池（第 ⑪、⑫ 步）。IMX636 在 1000 lux 的光照下延迟不到 100 µs，动态范围超过 120 dB，典型功耗 50 到 70 mW；Hala Point 标称每瓦每秒超过 15 万亿次 8 位运算。杯子开始滑、你的手突然伸过来，这种突然的变化正是事件相机最擅长看的。Strengths, and what it targets: Power consumption follows "how much is happening", and it is aimed at the robot’s latency and battery (steps ⑪ and ⑫). At 1000 lux the IMX636 has a latency under 100 µs, a dynamic range above 120 dB and a typical power of 50 to 70 mW; Hala Point quotes more than 15 trillion 8-bit operations per second per watt. The glass starting to slip, your hand suddenly reaching out: sudden changes like these are exactly what event cameras are best at seeing.
  • 为什么还没落地：脉冲网络还没有像反向传播那样通用好用的训练方法，同样的任务上准确率常常比不过普通的深度学习。今天的视觉–语言–动作模型都是 Transformer，按矩阵乘法设计，很难原样搬上去。软件和工具少，会用的人也少；Hala Point 这样的大系统仍是研究原型。事件相机输出的不是图像，现有的视觉模型和数据集大多用不上。Why it has not landed yet: Spiking networks still have no training method as general and easy to use as backpropagation, and on the same task their accuracy often falls short of ordinary deep learning. Today’s vision-language-action models are all Transformers, designed around matrix multiplication, and are hard to move across as they are. Software and tools are scarce, and so are people who know how to use them; large systems like Hala Point are still research prototypes. Event cameras do not output images, so most existing vision models and datasets cannot be used with them.
  • 对厨房机器人：最可能先用在最快的那几级环上：事件相机加一个小网络，做反射式的检测和跟踪，和大模型分工。For the kitchen robot: It will most likely be used first in the fastest loops: an event camera plus a small network for reflex-like detection and tracking, sharing the work with the large models.

6. 用随机性来算：热力学计算6. Computing with randomness: thermodynamic computing

很多生成模型其实是在"抽样"：扩散模型和流模型（π0 的动作专家就是一种流模型，第 ⑫ 步）从一团随机噪声出发，一步步变成一个动作。数字芯片从简单的随机数出发，要让神经网络算很多步，才能把它变成想要的分布。有人想反过来：让电路里天然的热噪声直接按编程好的分布去抽样。Many generative models are really "sampling": diffusion models and flow models (π0’s action expert is a flow model, step ⑫) start from a cloud of random noise and turn it, step by step, into an action. A digital chip starts from simple random numbers and has to run a neural network for many steps to turn them into the distribution it wants. Some people want to turn this around: let the natural thermal noise in a circuit sample directly from a programmed distribution.

  • 谁在做：初创公司 Extropic：2025 年第一季度做出原型芯片 X0，第三季度推出研究平台 XTR-0，计划 2027 年开始让 Z1 早期试用：M.2 卡上 50 多万个、PCIe 卡上 400 多万个"概率比特"（Extropic）。Who is working on it: The start-up Extropic, which made the prototype chip X0 in the first quarter of 2025, launched the research platform XTR-0 in the third quarter and plans to begin early access to Z1 in 2027: more than 500,000 "probabilistic bits" on an M.2 card and more than 4 million on a PCIe card (Extropic).
  • 长处，冲着什么：如果成立，抽样这类计算的能耗可以低得多，冲着生成式模型的能耗。Strengths, and what it targets: If it works, sampling-type computation could use far less energy; it is aimed at the energy of generative models.
  • 为什么还没落地：非常早期：规模小，还没有公开的、在真实大小的模型上和 GPU 对比的测量，算法也要专门为它重新设计。Why it has not landed yet: It is very early: the scale is small, there are no published measurements comparing it with GPUs on a model of realistic size, and algorithms have to be redesigned specially for it.
  • 对厨房机器人：是远期的可能：如果动作模型的"去噪"能直接用物理的随机性完成，生成动作也许能更省电。For the kitchen robot: It is a distant possibility: if an action model’s "denoising" could be done directly by physical randomness, generating actions might take less power.

对照：一条已经落地的路，传感器里算For contrast, a route already in commercial use: in-sensor computing

索尼 2020 年开始供货的 IMX500，在像素芯片下面叠了一块逻辑芯片，里面有专门做 AI 的数字信号处理器和存模型的内存；1230 万像素，跑 MobileNet V1 要 3.1 ms，输出的不是图像，而是"看到了什么"的元数据（Sony 2020）。它能落地，是因为问题小而明确：一个小模型、一路相机，用不着改变整个软件生态；代价是只能放小模型。它也指出了一条对机器人很实在的路：第 ⑪ 步那每秒 163 MB 里，99.7% 来自相机，在源头少传一点，后面每一级都轻松。Sony’s IMX500, shipping since 2020, stacks a logic chip beneath the pixel chip, holding a digital signal processor built for AI and memory to store the model; with 12.3 megapixels, it runs MobileNet V1 in 3.1 ms, and what comes out is not an image but metadata on "what it saw" (Sony 2020). It landed because the problem is small and well defined: one small model, one camera, no need to change the whole software ecosystem; the price is that only small models fit. It also points to a very practical route for the robot: of the 163 MB per second in step ⑪, 99.7% comes from the cameras, so sending a little less at the source eases every stage after it.

e = P / R

做一次运算花的能量，等于功率除以每秒做的运算次数。常听到的 TOPS/W（每瓦每秒多少万亿次运算）倒过来就是它：1 TOPS/W 正好是每次 1 pJ。The energy spent on one operation is the power divided by the number of operations per second. The familiar TOPS/W (trillions of operations per second per watt) is this turned upside down: 1 TOPS/W is exactly 1 pJ per operation.

每条路线都爱用这个数说明自己省电。它简单，却很容易比歪，看到一个数要先问清楚四件事：用几位的数（4 位还是 8 位）；稠密还是稀疏；算的是芯片的峰值，还是整个系统（内存、换算电路、激光器都算进去）在真实任务上的平均；以及能放下多大的模型。Every route likes to quote this number to show how little power it needs. It is simple, but comparisons with it easily go wrong, so when you see one, first pin down four things: how many bits the numbers have (4 or 8); dense or sparse; whether it is the chip’s peak or the whole system’s average on a real task (memory, conversion circuits and lasers all counted); and how big a model fits.

e
每次运算的能量，J（1 pJ = 10−12 J）energy per operation, J (1 pJ = 10−12 J)
P
功率，Wpower, W
R
每秒做的运算次数，次/秒operations per second, operations/s

B200：FP4 稠密峰值 9 × 1015 次/秒，整块 GPU（含 HBM）最多 1000 W，e = 1000 / (9 × 1015) ≈ 0.11 pJ。IBM 的模拟芯片：芯片实测最高 12.4 TOPS/W（8 位输入输出），e ≈ 0.08 pJ；把整个系统算进去估计是 6.7 TOPS/W，e ≈ 0.15 pJ。EnCharge EN100（M.2）：200 TOPS / 8.25 W ≈ 24 TOPS/W，e ≈ 0.04 pJ（没说精度）。清华"太极"：片上 160 TOPS/W，e ≈ 0.006 pJ（只算芯片上的光学部分）。第一代 TPU（2015 年起用，2017 年发表，28 nm，8 位）：峰值 92 TOPS，典型功耗 40 W，2.3 TOPS/W，e ≈ 0.43 pJ（Jouppi 等 2017）。纸面上最大和最小差了约 70 倍，可这几对数字几乎没有一对能直接比：精度、稀疏与否、芯片还是系统、峰值还是实测、14 nm 还是 4 nm，都不一样。B200: FP4 dense peak 9 × 1015 operations/s, at most 1000 W for the whole GPU (HBM included), e = 1000 / (9 × 1015) ≈ 0.11 pJ. IBM’s analogue chip: up to 12.4 TOPS/W measured on the chip (8-bit inputs and outputs), e ≈ 0.08 pJ; counting the whole system, an estimated 6.7 TOPS/W, e ≈ 0.15 pJ. EnCharge EN100 (M.2): 200 TOPS / 8.25 W ≈ 24 TOPS/W, e ≈ 0.04 pJ (precision not stated). Tsinghua’s "Taichi": 160 TOPS/W on chip, e ≈ 0.006 pJ (counting only the optical part on the chip). The first-generation TPU (in service from 2015, published in 2017, 28 nm, 8-bit): peak 92 TOPS, typical power 40 W, 2.3 TOPS/W, e ≈ 0.43 pJ (Jouppi et al. 2017). On paper the largest and the smallest differ by a factor of about 70, yet hardly any two of these figures can be compared directly: precision, sparsity, chip or system, peak or measured, 14 nm or 4 nm all differ.

公平的比法，是同一个模型、同样的准确率，完成一次任务一共花多少焦耳。IBM"比 MLPerf 里能效最好的提交高 14 倍"就是在往这个方向比；可它比的是一个语音模型，不是几十亿参数的 Transformer。新路线最难证明的，正是在大模型上也一样省。The fair way to compare is how many joules in total it takes to complete a task with the same model at the same accuracy. IBM’s "14 times more energy-efficient than the best submission in MLPerf" is a comparison in that direction; but what it compares is a speech model, not a Transformer with billions of parameters. What the new routes find hardest to prove is exactly that they save just as much on large models.
